confidence_notes: FX comes from a search of RBA pages, which gave 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors rest on one general search. That search returned venue menus and a Time Out pub-menu analysis, not a city price index. Beer, coffee and cocktail figures reflect Crown Melbourne menus and similar venues, converted to USD. The inexpensive-meal and mid-range-meal figures are bounded estimates from general knowledge, not searched city averages. Wine is estimated from the local price relationship to beer and the search's rough A$14-18 glass range. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not inspect any booking pages or listings. The pricing window is July 2026, which is winter and off-peak. Accommodation is the least certain group.
comparable_city_reasoning: Sydney is the closest comparable, and Melbourne is typically slightly cheaper for accommodation. Auckland and other high-cost developed-world cities were also considered.
